'''''Starspin''''' was a [[YT-1210 light freighter/Legends|YT-1210 light freighter]] owned and operated by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Cev Malanx]] and [[Regec Sloom]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the ''Starspin'' smuggled goods throughout the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]].
